text:
Yes, there is a candidate, but it is not yet corroborated.

Hansen data show a tree-cover loss event of 13.5 ha in 2025, about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property. The JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of the event area, so the area was forest at the baseline. The context is native forest.

The status is "pending corroboration". 2025 is the latest year in the series, and the rule requires a later year of observation to confirm the change is persistent.

The evidence does not show:
- that deforestation or land-use change occurred, since Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as harvesting a plantation
- the cause (harvest, fire, storm or clearing)
- whether the change was legal
- any compliance finding, such as EUDR status

The MGAP 2021 source was not available. Treat this as a lead for follow-up, not a conclusion.
